RUN set -eu; curl -fsSLo /tmp/rustup-init https://static.rust-lang.org/rustup/archive/1.29.3/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/rustup-init; echo 'b1c8cb14e30889e7e2999e6b69e62d9e9b9ffc0f4df8180564d306d9680e6c55  /tmp/rustup-init' | sha256sum -c -; chmod 755 /tmp/rustup-init; RUSTUP_HOME=/opt/rust/rustup CARGO_HOME=/opt/rust/cargo /tmp/rustup-init -y --no-modify-path --profile minimal --default-toolchain 1.96.1 --component clippy,rustfmt; rm /tmp/rustup-init; chmod -R a+rX /opt/rust

RUN set -eu; rustc --version | grep -q '^rustc 1\.96\.1 '; cargo clippy --version; rustfmt --version; test "$(zig version)" = 0.16.0; test "$(node --version)" = v24.22.1; test "$(bun --version)" = 1.3.14; test "$(just --version)" = 'just 1.59.0'; cargo nextest --version | grep -q '^cargo-nextest 0\.9\.149 '; ctest --version | grep -q '^ctest version 4\.4\.3$'

build:
set -eu
jobs=$1
build=/w/build
mkdir -p "$build"
cargo fetch --locked
cargo nextest run --locked --no-run --build-jobs "$jobs"
cat > "$build/compile-jobs.sh" <<'JOBS'
# Runs a check with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS sized for the machine running it, which may be smaller than the
# machine that wrote this file: its vCPUs, at most its memory at 2 GiB a job (the recipe's build_job_memory_gib).
set -eu
cpus=$(nproc)
read -r _ kib _ < /proc/meminfo
bytes=$((kib * 1024))
if [ -r /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max ]; then
  read -r cap < /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max
  if [ "$cap" != max ] && [ "$cap" -lt "$bytes" ]; then bytes=$cap; fi
fi
jobs=$((bytes / 2147483648))
if [ "$jobs" -gt "$cpus" ]; then jobs=$cpus; fi
if [ "$jobs" -lt 1 ]; then jobs=1; fi
export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=$jobs
exec "$@"
JOBS
cat > "$build/CTestTestfile.cmake.new" <<'CTEST'
# Written by the build step of services/builder/recipes/herdr-fast-api.json. See herdr-fast-api-notes.md there.
# The Linux CI gate, not all of `just check`: lint, ci-tests and docs-contract-test from it, windows-lint not
# here, plus ghostty-scalar, the scalar libghostty check of the fork's Linux CI job, in its own target folder.
# RESOURCE_LOCK cargo: one check compiles at a time, so one machine's compile allowance is not spent twice.
# TIMEOUT 0: no time limit on a test.
add_test(lint bash /w/build/compile-jobs.sh just lint)
set_tests_properties(lint PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY /w/src RESOURCE_LOCK cargo TIMEOUT 0 LABELS check)
add_test(ci-tests bash /w/build/compile-jobs.sh just ci-tests)
set_tests_properties(ci-tests PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY /w/src RESOURCE_LOCK cargo TIMEOUT 0 LABELS check)
add_test(docs-contract-test just docs-contract-test)
set_tests_properties(docs-contract-test PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY /w/src TIMEOUT 0 LABELS check)
add_test(ghostty-scalar bash /w/build/compile-jobs.sh cargo nextest run --locked -E "package(ghostty-vt) | test(ghostty)" --status-level fail --final-status-level fail --failure-output final --success-output never)
set_tests_properties(ghostty-scalar PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY /w/src RESOURCE_LOCK cargo TIMEOUT 0 ENVIRONMENT "LIBGHOSTTY_VT_SIMD=false;LIBGHOSTTY_VT_OPTIMIZE=ReleaseSafe;CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/w/build/target-scalar" LABELS ci)
CTEST
mv -f "$build/CTestTestfile.cmake.new" "$build/CTestTestfile.cmake"
